posts.title: A reply problem, not a lead problem
posts.hook: Most GCC SMEs don't have a lead problem. They have a reply problem.
posts.body:
A buyer fills your form at 10:40pm. They message 3 suppliers. The first one to answer gets the call.

It's rarely the best supplier. It's the fastest.

So before you spend another dirham on ads, find the slowest first reply in last week's inbox. Not the average. The worst one.

If it's longer than an hour, your next lead campaign will leak the same way. Fix the reply time first. Then buy more leads.
posts.cta: What's the slowest reply you've found in your own inbox?

posts.title: Stop sending the PDF
posts.hook: Stop sending your price list as a PDF.
posts.body: Buyers don't open it on their phone. Send 3 lines instead: your starting price, what's included, and 1 question about their project. Then offer 2 call times.
posts.cta: Follow for 1 sales fix a week.

posts.title: Deals lost in the inbox
posts.hook: Most deals aren't lost on price. They're lost in the inbox.
posts.body:
The buyer asked a simple question on Thursday night. The answer went out on Sunday morning.

Nobody lowered the price. Nobody lost a pitch. The thread went quiet and the buyer moved on.

Before your next discount, read your last 10 lost deals and check when each one got its first reply.
posts.cta: Which would you rather fix first: your price or your reply time?
